message.content: Research is complete. News flow is neutral-to-constructive (iPhone 16 demand and Apple Intelligence rollout being weighed), and the stock is trading at $222.70. I'll place a single buy order sized within the $10,000 per-order cap.
message.reasoning:

That's under $10,000. 45 shares × $223 = $10,035 > $10,000. So 44 shares.

Let me place the order.
